newsitem.title: USA: Passenger jet skids off runway in Ohio.
newsitem.headline: Passenger jet skids off runway in Ohio.

text.p: An American Airlines jet skidded off the runway upon landing at Cleveland Hopkins International Airport in sleet and snow about 9 p.m. EST (0200 GMT) Wednesday, the airline said.
The right landing gear collapsed as the McDonnell-Douglas MD-80 came to rest in a mud just off the runway, the airline said.
The 103 passengers and six crew members were evacuated via slides, apparently without serious injury, airline spokeswoman Andrea Rader said in a telephone interview.
"There were some minor injuries reported but as far as we know, nobody went to a hospital," she said.

Flight 320 had left Dallas-Fort Worth Airport in Texas about two-and-one-half hours earlier, Rader said. WKYC-TV3 in Cleveland reported the flight originated in Los Angeles, but Rader said she could not confirm that.
The FAA said it is investigating the incident.
